title: component-partition.v1
description: Output of code-comprehension/partition.py: a bounded synthetic component partition over an arbitrary code repo. Schema-compatible with progress/contract-map.yaml on exactly the fields downstream consumers read (components[].{id, source_paths}); carries partition-specific extras (canonical file inventory, per-component cost report, provenance). NEVER written under progress/ (collision hazard). UNSIGNED.

provenance.description: Marks this map as auto-synthesized + unsigned. A real signed contract-map carries no such marker. Downstream tooling must refuse to treat a synthetic-unsigned map as a gate-bearing contract-map.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC. NOT hashed into partition_hash (cosmetic only).

partition_hash.description: sha256 over the canonical (id, sorted source_files) projection of components[]. Excludes generated_at. The C5 canonical inventory is the hashed surface.

tree_state.description: C12 — explicit working-tree state at partition time, so freshness reflects the real tree (not just the git index).

tree_hash.description: git write-tree if available, else null

config.description: The tunable thresholds in effect for this run (one config block bob can tune). Recorded for reproducibility.

cap.description: max component count (default 12; long tail collapses into 'misc')

fragment_pct_threshold.description: over-partition trigger: fraction of candidate components resolving to <=1 file (default 0.40)

per_component_token_budget.description: aggregate est-token cap fed to intent-extract per component before auto-degrade (factors in 2x two-arm)

decisions.description: Auto-resolution log (§13 no-pause): every cap/split/collapse-tail/degrade decision the partitioner made WITHOUT a user pause. Post-hoc inspectable.

id.description: component id. Consumed by wiring resolver + intent-extract (must match).

source_paths.description: Directory-prefix globs (consumed by wiring's prefix-matching resolver AND intent-extract's glob loader). For determinism these are project-relative.

source_files.description: C5 CANONICAL EXPANDED FILE INVENTORY — explicit project-relative file paths, exactly one component per file. Consumed identically by wiring resolution, partitioning, hashing, and intent-extract. This is the authoritative member set; source_paths is the glob view for the resolver.

entry_points.description: detected entry-point markers seeding this component (reused from static.jsonl, never re-detected)

intent_mode.description: llm = full intent-extract pass; structural-only = unsupported language (no LLM); degraded = over-budget auto-degrade (LLM skipped, confidence badge)

cost.description: pre-flight visible cost (before any LLM spend)

inputs.description: empty on a synthetic map (no typed contract on a legacy repo)
